annotations.title: Sold prices for a UK postcode (HM Land Registry)

description: Recorded sale prices for one full UK postcode in England or Wales, newest first, from HM Land Registry Price Paid data: address, price (GBP), completion date, property type, tenure and whether it was a new build. Returns an attribution statement that MUST be shown with the figures (Open Government Licence). Sale prices only — never ownership records. An empty result means no recorded sales at that exact postcode; try a neighbouring one. Scotland and Northern Ireland are not covered by this data.

limit.description: How many sales to return (default 12, max 50)
